summary: Describes the minimal properties an IP Encapsulating Security Payload implementation needs to stay interoperable with standard ESP in RFC 4303. It is not meant to replace ESP, but to allow optimized implementations for constrained environments. It is informational.

eli5.summary: A full toolbox is heavy for tiny devices. This says which tools they can leave out and still work with everyone who has the full box.

questions: how to implement esp on constrained devices
